notes: A custom field used by a scoring rule can be deleted (204). The rule keeps the dead entry, the list shows nothing wrong, records quietly lose those points (9 → 0) on their next save, and opening the rule shows an empty field that cannot be saved ("This field is not in the module."). Zoho refuses the delete: "The custom field has already used in other places". Medium. Image uk1-deleted-field-rule.png.
